cases.description: ichunked with zero size must produce no chunks without consuming input; negative size must raise ValueError mentioning n must be at least 0. Preserve positive chunking.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: A missing bucket lookup or membership check must not invent keys when iterating bucket keys. Existing bucket contents and valid keys must remain available.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: numeric_range with inexact float steps must recognize each item it yields, return its correct index, and report a length matching iteration. Preserve exact integer ranges and nonmember rejection.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: chunked must reject negative sizes with a clear ValueError containing n must be at least 0, for empty and nonempty inputs. Preserve positive and None sizes.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: numeric_range objects yielding the same singleton must compare equal regardless of step and have equal hashes. Preserve unequal ranges and equality of empty ranges.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: sliced must reject negative slice sizes with ValueError under both strict modes, rather than silently yielding incorrect slices. Preserve positive slicing.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: windowed must raise ValueError for zero or negative window sizes, including empty sources; preserve positive window padding and step validation.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: locate and replace with window_size must never pass internal padding sentinels to user predicates. Tail calls may contain fewer actual items; preserve window matching and replacement.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: nth_combination_with_replacement must allow r larger than the pool length. Empty pool with r zero has one empty combination; invalid indexes raise IndexError. Preserve ordinary combinations.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: nth_permutation for a requested size greater than the pool length must raise IndexError because no such permutation exists. Negative size remains ValueError; preserve valid indexed permutations.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: nth_product and product_index with repeat must handle one-shot iterators like reusable sequences, materializing each input only once. Preserve ordinary product indexing.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: gray_product and partial_product with repeat must preserve output when inputs are one-shot iterators. Preserve ordinary traversal with reusable sequences.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: Reversing numeric_range must preserve the exact float values yielded by forward iteration, and avoid overflow for datetime boundary ranges. Preserve integer reversal and empty ranges.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: zip_broadcast must open a single-use iterable only once, rather than probing iterability then opening it again. Preserve scalar broadcasting and normal zip behavior.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: last must propagate TypeError from a user-defined reversed implementation, including when a default is supplied. Preserve default handling for empty iterables and ordinary last items.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: xfrange must support descending ranges and produce the same count as frange for inexact ascending steps. Preserve positive integer-step ranges.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: backoff must accept start zero, advance to one, and then grow exponentially up to stop. Preserve positive-start backoff and explicit counts.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: backoff_iter count repeat must accept a dynamically constructed equal string, without relying on object identity. Preserve finite counts and bounded exponential values.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: partition_all must raise LookupError if a sequence reports a length inconsistent with its contents instead of emitting padding or dropping values. Preserve correct lists and iterators.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.

cases.description: merge_with must accept a single collections.abc Mapping that is not a dict, treating it as a mapping rather than an iterable of mappings. Preserve merging multiple dictionaries.
cases.provenance: Public fix inspected by task author; no model outcome selection; held out from strategy tuning only.
